description: Binding providers under additional shapes: an explicit boundType combined with multibinding=true is exposed as a set-multibinding element, and a single binding declared in a multi-segment package reports its provider direction correctly.

sources:
package com.example

import software.amazon.lastmile.kotlin.inject.anvil.ContributesBinding
import me.tatarka.inject.annotations.Inject

interface Base
interface Middle : Base

@Inject
@ContributesBinding(Unit::class, boundType = Base::class, multibinding = true)
class Impl : Middle

cases.expected_output:
status=compiled
contribution origin=com.example.Impl
provides from=com.example.Impl to=com.example.Base kind=multi

sources:
package com.foo.bar

import software.amazon.lastmile.kotlin.inject.anvil.ContributesBinding
import me.tatarka.inject.annotations.Inject

interface Service

@Inject
@ContributesBinding(Unit::class)
class RealService : Service

cases.expected_output:
status=compiled
contribution origin=com.foo.bar.RealService
provides from=com.foo.bar.RealService to=com.foo.bar.Service kind=single
